claim: The theoretically expected abundance of lithium-7, based on standard nuclear and particle physics and generic astrophysical assumptions, exceeds the observed abundance in old, metal-poor Milky Way halo stars by a factor of approximately 3.5.
falsifier: The claim can be tested by further spectroscopic observations of lithium-7 in additional old, metal-poor stars and by refining theoretical models.

conditions: based on absorption spectroscopy in photospheres of old, metal-poor Milky Way halo stars
assuming standard nuclear and particle physics and generic astrophysical assumptions
exclusions: Evidence is limited to the specific stellar population and observational method reported; transfer to other environments or different assumptions is unestablished.
